technology_name: HYDROCARBON BASED REFRIGERANT MIXTURE FOR A SOLAR ASSISTED HEAT PUMP SYSTEM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional heat pump systems rely on fluorocarbon-based R22 refrigerants that exhibit severe Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP) and high Global Warming Potential (GWP).
description: A sustainable hydrocarbon-based refrigerant mixture (HBRM) composed of 50% refrigerant-grade propane (R290) and 50% refrigerant-grade propylene (R1270) optimized for direct-expansion solar heat pumps.
applications: Solar-assisted domestic water heaters, commercial space heating installations, eco-friendly HVAC units, and industrial low-temperature drying arrays.
